visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a white cable-knit sweater stands on an urban sidewalk. He has his arms crossed and looks up at the sky with a thoughtful expression. The background shows blurred street elements, trees, and city buildings under bright natural daylight. (2) A second man with shoulder-length black hair enters the scene from the side, heavily dressed in a thick olive-green winter parka and a voluminous black scarf. The first man reacts with exaggerated facial expressions, eyes wide and mouth open in shock. (3) The scene shifts to close-ups of both men talking. The environment is a typical city street with visible shop signs and distant traffic. The lighting is consistent and bright. The first man looks confused while the second man gestures with his hands to explain a point. (4) A third man appears, wearing only a black sleeveless tank top. He stands confidently with his hands on his hips. Animated sweat drops and steam lines are overlaid around his head to emphasize he is hot despite the cold weather. The other two men stand next to him looking bewildered. (5) The three men interact in a group shot. The tank-top man points to his stomach. The background remains an urban street. The visual rhythm is fast with frequent cuts between their reaction shots. (6) The video ends with a group reaction where the first two men look into the camera with wide eyes and open mouths while the third man smiles broadly with a thumbs-up gesture.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 防寒裝備的差異. [Subtitle]: (你住台灣幾年了?). (2) [Variety]: 在台第一年. [Subtitle]: 台灣也進入冬天了啊... (3) [Subtitle]: 不過今天是不是有點冷? 明明看了天氣預報. 怎麼搞的呢? (4) [Variety]: 喔,第三年!. [Subtitle]: 什麼!?. (5) [Subtitle]: 喂,你這樣穿也太誇張了吧! 今天有15度耶. 在日本還算是秋天的氣溫呢!. (6) [Slogan]: 菜逼八你可別輕敵了!. [Subtitle]: 台灣的冬天可跟日本的不一樣... (7) [Variety]: 濕,濕度!?. [Subtitle]: 夏天會又熱又黏. (8) [Subtitle]: 反之冬天就會覺得特別陰冷. 如果不考慮體感溫度就會穿錯衣服. (9) [Subtitle]: 怪不得15度就這麼冷了. 看來之後得帶暖暖包. 做好防寒準備了. (10) [Variety]: 喔,第十年!. [Subtitle]: 你來得有點晚了. (11) [Variety]: 什麼!?. [Subtitle]: 喂喂喂. 這麼冷你穿這麼少? 這樣下去乳頭都要硬了而且還會透出來啊!. (12) [Slogan]: 菜逼八你可別輕敵了!. [Subtitle]: 我的乳頭... 既不會硬也不會透!!. (13) [Subtitle]: 這怎麼可能啊~!. 等等,第三年. 你仔細看. (14) [Variety]: 汗!?. [Subtitle]: 這麼冷還在流汗怎麼回事?. (15) [Subtitle]: 那是因為... 我的胃裡有個暖暖包!. [Variety]: 什麼!?. (16) [Subtitle]: 胃裡有暖暖包是什麼意思?. 就是這個!. (17) [Variety]: 薑母鴨!?. [Subtitle]: 生薑加米酒的湯底. 從內到外暖透身心. (18) [Subtitle]: 只要喝了這個. 什麼寒冷都能撐過去!. 這就是... 傳說中的暖暖包料理!!. (19) [Subtitle]: 原來如此~. 不過,消化了之後效果不就沒了嗎?. 那時候嘛... 就趕快回家. 也是啦~.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with a calm, reflective tone in Japanese over a light acoustic guitar melody. The pace is moderate and conversational. (2) A sharp comedic 'boing' SFX triggers a transition to a much louder, high-pitched male voice expressing surprise. The BGM remains steady. (3) Rapid-fire dialogue between two males occurs, characterized by high variability in pitch and frequent comical sound effects like 'ding' and 'whoosh.' (4) A third male voice enters with an authoritative and energetic tone. A 'sparkle' SFX sounds as he presents himself. (5) The dialogue density increases as all three voices overlap with expressive shouting and laughter. A rhythmic synth beat joins the guitar in the BGM. (6) A loud group shout of a specific food name is followed by a sudden 'thud' SFX and a humorous, lower-volume closing remark as the music fades.
